title: Checkerboard Shells: A Position-Only Thin-Shell Discretization with Scale-Compatible Completion
summary: Checkerboard edge-midpoint geometry provides an exact planar Varignon parallelogram for every spatial quadrilateral, allowing a local tangent frame and normal to be recovered directly from nodal positions even when the raw quadrilateral is warped. Building on this property, we develop a position-only thin-shell discretization with no independent director, rotation, or strain variables.
